revision_purpose: Replace length-revealing and remote choices with concise, workflow-adjacent contrasts without changing requested actions.
semantic_scope: All 240 choice sets reauthored directly. Original states, questions, split, group_id, task_family, arity, ordered option IDs, target ID and target slot are unchanged. Targets express the same requested action, retaining consequential timing, conditions and partial-action scope; no new facts are asserted about the scenario. Only choice texts, example ID prefix and provenance change.

generation_settings.method: Direct approved-agent teacher authoring of each complete choice set; stdlib CPU mapping and serialization only.

sampling.note: Harness sampling settings unavailable; no additional model/API calls.

generation_settings.option_order: Parent order unchanged; no diagnostic-driven reshuffling or relabeling.

usage_constraints.origin: Synthetic parent scenarios and direct revision through existing approved agent access; applicable provider terms remain in force.
usage_constraints.privacy: No private company or customer records used.
usage_constraints.features: Only state, question and option text are model inputs; all lineage and labels are metadata.
usage_constraints.validation: Validation rows are for validation only, never weight updates.
usage_constraints.replacement: Use this revision instead of the parent, not alongside its same-group rows.

limitations: Same-teacher semantic self-review, not independent correctness verification.
No immutable teacher revision or sampling parameters exposed.
No model/tokenizer load; downstream token-budget audit remains necessary.
Deduplication scope is this shard and its parent lineage only.
